content.short: Horizon Protocol is a decentralized derivatives and liquidity protocol.
content.description: Horizon Protocol uses a peer-to-pool model that does not require a counterparty for trades, enabling DeFi traders to access low fees, deep liquidity, and zero slippage when trading borderless synthetic assets. It extends cross-chain reach across BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Ethereum, and Sui, broadening liquidity and accessibility for synthetic exposure. It also prioritizes a seamless UI/UX and educational content to help the community understand DeFi derivatives, making complex instruments more approachable while preserving the benefits of decentralized trading across supported chains.
